about.title: About Ottor Mastar
about.intro: "Ottor Mastar" is a project dedicated to the wild herbs and trees of Yakutia (Sakha Republic).
about.intro_mongolia: "Ottor Mastar" is a project dedicated to the wild herbs and trees of Mongolia.
about.mission: Our mission is to introduce people to the remarkable plant world of Yakutia — its beauty and benefits.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist. Return to the gallery to browse plants.

common.disclaimerShort: For educational use only — not medical or safety advice. Never gather, prepare, or use a plant based on this app; many are poisonous. Consult a professional.

help.title: Help
help.intro: A quick guide to the herbarium.
help.browseBody: The Gallery shows every plant as a photo tile. The Catalog is an alphabetical index with search and category filters — search also looks inside descriptions.
help.viewerBody: Tap any image to open it full screen. Pinch or double-tap to zoom, drag to pan, swipe down to close. On a plant page, swipe sideways (or use the dots) to switch between the botanical plate and the field photo.
help.langBody: Switch the interface language with the buttons in the header. In Settings you can also switch the collection (country); each collection offers its own languages.
help.appBody: In the Android app every plant, picture and text works without an internet connection.
help.safetyBody: Everything here is for education only — never gather or use plants based on this app.
